intro: Every word this module’s exercises use, on one deck of flashcards: 289 cards, 97 of them nouns. The vocabulary of this module is the language of society, work, environment and science, much of it abstract nouns in -ung, -heit, -keit and -ion, from the themes Umwelt & Klima, Wissenschaft & Forschung, Ernährung & Gesundheit, Orte & Regionen. Write the German, choose it from four options, or flip the card and rate yourself. A word you miss comes back later in the same run, and stays in your weak words until you get it right three times in a row.
tips[0].title: Suffixes give the gender away
tips[0].text: Most abstract nouns are feminine because of their suffix: -ung, -heit, -keit, -schaft, -ion and -tät always take die. Use the suffix, not memory, when you are unsure.
tips[0].check.why: Nouns ending in -heit are always feminine: die Gesundheit.
tips[1].title: Cause and effect come as word pairs
tips[1].text: die Ursache – die Folge, führen zu, zurückführen auf: the environment vocabulary is built for explaining why something happens and what follows.
tips[1].check.why: Ursache is the cause, Folge the consequence.
tips[2].title: Formal prepositions want the genitive
tips[2].text: trotz, aufgrund, infolge, innerhalb, außerhalb, anhand, mithilfe, anlässlich, bezüglich: learn each one with a short genitive phrase.
tips[2].check.why: infolge takes the genitive: des Sturms.
remember[0]: Never say a noun without its article, not even in your head.
remember[1]: Miss a word? It comes back in the same run. Three correct answers in a row take it off the weak list.
remember[2]: Verbs and adjectives have no article: type them as they stand, like "nachweisen".
hook: Environment, science, health and regions: the abstract nouns you need to discuss real issues, each with its article.
